item.title: The Meeting — Lessons Learned
item.description: Three meetings. Three paradigm shifts. A personal reflection on why the most impactful conversations happen outside the agenda — and how embracing the unexpected unlocked a new level of cross-functional engagement across our organisation.

item.title: The Meeting — Rebecca and the Lighting Strategy
item.description: Rebecca leaves a tedious meeting to collect a parcel. She ordered one lamp. Six spill out on the pavement. The meeting is listening. Corporate logic does the rest.

item.title: The Meeting — Graham and the Great Tea Crisis
item.description: Graham runs out of teabags mid-meeting. What follows is a crisis of national proportions, a queue at the corner shop, and an accidental unmute that derails the entire agenda into retail economics.

item.title: The Meeting — Nigel and the Grocery Run
item.description: During an endless Teams meeting, Nigel discovers that nobody is really paying attention — until a self-checkout machine betrays him.

item.title: Message Home: Quick Check-In on the Return Trip
item.description: The visitors sent a message home while on their return trip. What they said is nothing like what we experienced.

item.title: After They Left: Living in the Shadows
item.description: They came, did their thing, and left. Now all we have is the debris, the silence, and the questions that won’t go away.

item.title: While They Stayed: The World in Chaos
item.description: They were here for a few hours, and the world couldn’t handle it. This is what it was like while they stayed.

item.title: The Day They Came: A Stranger's Recount
item.description: They came from the sky, and nothing’s been the same since. This is what I’ve pieced together about that day.
